code: # Six barcodes over two disjoint blocks of cells; barcodes 1-3 share one # per-cell rate profile and 4-6 another, so they cluster into two groups. set.seed(10) rate_a <- stats::runif(100, min = 5, max = 50) rate_b <- stats::runif(100, min = 5, max = 50) zero_vec <- rep(0, 100) lin_mat <- rbind(c(stats::rpois(100, rate_a), zero_vec),                  c(stats::rpois(100, rate_a), zero_vec),                  c(stats::rpois(100, rate_a), zero_vec),                  c(zero_vec, stats::rpois(100, rate_b)),                  c(zero_vec, stats::rpois(100, rate_b)),                  c(zero_vec, stats::rpois(100, rate_b))) rownames(lin_mat) <- paste0("bc", 1:6) colnames(lin_mat) <- paste0("cell", 1:200) lin_mat <- Matrix::Matrix(lin_mat, sparse = TRUE) res <- barcode_clustering(lin_mat = lin_mat, cell_lower_limit = 50) res$lineage_clusters #> $c1 #> [1] "bc1" "bc2" "bc3" #>  #> $c2 #> [1] "bc4" "bc5" "bc6" #>
